games.summary: Essendon edge out a battle-of-the-bottom contest against Richmond at the MCG. Wheelo rates ESS a clear 16 points above RIC in overall quality, and ESS benefits from RIC's inflated schedule (+1 win, all against bottom-4) and an atrocious ODELO record at the MCG (-18.5). However, ESS have their own problems — three losses by 40+ in their last five, the worst in the competition, and a bleeding flag after last week's 43-point loss to Fremantle. RIC's recent back-to-back form is fractionally less catastrophic than ESS's, dragging the margin back to 12. Jayden Short plays his 200th game for RIC, and Ben McKay returns for ESS.
